event_summary: A metal-ball desktop cradle shows one outer ball moving into the row, followed by alternating outward swings of the opposite outer balls.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a chrome ball-and-frame desktop cradle on a black base, with a blue-and-black handled object lying to the left. Several shiny suspended balls hang close together near the center while the left outer suspended ball is displaced toward the left. After a static interval, the left outer ball moves inward toward the clustered balls. The right outer ball then separates from the row and swings to the right before returning. The left and right outer balls continue alternating outward and inward motion while the middle balls remain mostly close together.

reasons: The cradle frame, base, suspended balls, strings, tabletop, and left-side handled object are visible.
The suspended balls are not yet undergoing the later alternating outward swings.
The left displaced ball is partly near the left frame and handled object.
